issue_context.summary: A static circle from Mouse Highlighter reportedly remains visible when switching to Ripple mode, but the exact active-state and settings sequence is not yet documented.

inferences: The symptom may involve transient drawing state during settings application, but current evidence does not establish whether Mouse Highlighter was active, a button was held, or a fade animation was in progress.
issue_context.analysis: The missing sequence is decision-changing because current code explicitly clears and restarts drawing when settings are applied. Posting another request would duplicate the existing author-feedback request.

PR #48232 introduced the Ripple effect and PR #49699 later moved ripple work off the low-level hook.
Targeted duplicate search found only this open issue for the stuck Ripple/circle symptom.
